title: Wayfare Pass Ride Credit — Clawback on Adjusted Fares Calculation Sheet
content:
# Clawback of Pass ride credit on adjusted fares — calculation sheet (Wayfare Pass)

**Definition.** When a fare that earned Pass ride credit for a Wayfare Pass (rider membership) member is reduced by fare adjustments, the clawed-back credit depends on what the adjustments left of the fare: where they took back less than a tenth of the eligible fare (the fare charge less the booking fee) and left the fare charge net of its adjustments, less the ride option's booking fee, at or above the plan's minimum eligible fare, nothing is clawed back; where they took back at least a tenth of the eligible fare and left it at or above that minimum, the credit earned on the trip is multiplied by the amount taken back over the eligible fare and rounded half up to the cent; where they left it under that minimum, the whole credit earned on the trip is clawed back.

The clawed-back credit sets the credit correction owed on the trip. A tenth is 10 percent. The minimum eligible fare is 5.00 on every Wayfare Pass plan.

## Records, all in Wayfare Rides (rider trips and fares) unless stated

| Item | Record |
|---|---|
| Fare charge | The trip's fare charge |
| Amount taken back | The total of the fare adjustments that name that fare charge, as a positive amount |
| Booking fee | The booking fee of the trip's ride option |
| Eligible fare | The fare charge less the booking fee, never below 0.00 |
| Credit earned on the trip | The trip's credit earn entry on the Wayfare Pass membership ledger |

## Decision table

| What the adjustments left (eligible fare less amount taken back) | Share taken back | Clawed-back credit |
|---|---|---|
| 5.00 or more | under 10 percent of the eligible fare | nothing |
| 5.00 or more | 10 percent of the eligible fare or more | credit earned multiplied by amount taken back over eligible fare, rounded half up to the cent |
| under 5.00 | any | the whole credit earned on the trip |

## Worked cases (hypothetical: fare charge 32.70, booking fee 2.70, eligible fare 30.00, credit earned 1.80)

1. Adjustment of 2.99: under a tenth, 27.01 left. Clawed back: nothing.
2. Adjustment of 3.00: exactly a tenth, 27.00 left. Clawed back: 1.80 multiplied by 3.00 over 30.00, that is 0.18.
3. Adjustment of 6.00: 20 percent taken back, 24.00 left. Clawed back: 0.36.
4. Adjustments of 26.00 in total: 4.00 left, under 5.00. Clawed back: the whole 1.80.
